detail.longDescription:
Deleting repositories from GitHub slowly. From 40 down to 16. 

Over the course of about 10 years, many of them have shown that nobody needs them. They covered a broad range of interests: 
reviving abandoned libraries, 
games (C++, PyGame, Godot), 
machine learning (spiking networks in Python (just a prototype), reinforcement learning in Rust, and symbolic regression in C++ (got only 80% on the Titanic challenge so far)),
Android apps (drum machine, task management),
website development tools (like a spider that can recursively find all links available on my website, so I can load this data into GraphViz and… first, enjoy the graph, but then, maybe add some more links to tiny islands just to please Google’s rating algorithm)
 :blobDab: 
#github
